title: Bitwise Inversion Mirror
description: An IoT telemetry device transmits status reports as signed 32-bit integer flags. Due to a hardware sensor jitter, the incoming bitstream registers in reverse order. Write a function that accepts a 32-bit signed integer flag, mirrors its binary representation bit-for-bit, and returns the resulting signed integer. If the reversed binary value falls outside the range of a signed 32-bit integer [ -2^31, 2^31 - 1 ], return 0.
output_format: A single 32-bit signed integer representing the bit-reversed value, or 0 if it overflows.

examples.explanation: Reversing the binary representation of -3 under 32-bit constraints results in -1073741825.
Reversing all zeros results in zero.
